features-persona-avatar.source: Audited cat-head-gallery pool (50 keys, index updated 2026-10-21T01:17:37.109Z, cap 40960 bytes), minus the three persona defaults and the 10 Fun-section world covers (the ten cat heads the hero strip showed before 2026-10-25 stay out too), so no cat head repeats on the page

unchangedSurfaces.reason: The stage already holds the product overview video and the workflow board; a still image would add a second focal point beside the primary download call to action.
The board is a CSS systems visual that DESIGN.md asks to keep legible; a backdrop image would compete with its lanes.
Product screenshots are meaningful evidence and never change.
The entry previews are the Douyin and WeChat QR codes from the about snapshot, which are meaningful and have their own alt text.
The footer block is rendered by the shared Hagilight footer (@hagicode/hagilight-core); its avatar belongs to the Hagilight footer change and would duplicate here.
